rules.message: ECB mode detected in OpenSSL EVP usage; avoid for confidential data.
rules.remediation: Use AEAD ciphers like AES-GCM or implement authenticated encryption.

rules.message: MD5 detected in C/C++ code; do not use for cryptographic purposes.
RAND_pseudo_bytes is deprecated and may not be cryptographically secure.
AES-GCM (AEAD) detected; best practice for authenticated encryption.
rules.remediation: Continue using AES-GCM or similar AEAD modes.

rules.message: CBC mode detected; ensure HMAC is applied for authentication.
rules.remediation: Use GCM mode or apply Encrypt-then-MAC pattern with HMAC-SHA256.

rules.message: RSA key size below 2048 bits detected.
rules.remediation: Use RSA-2048 minimum (3072+ preferred) or modern hybrid/PQC strategy.

rules.message: Legacy RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 padding constant detected.
rules.remediation: Prefer OAEP for encryption and modern signature settings.

rules.message: Legacy OpenSSL SSL context method detected; verify protocol options disable SSLv2/SSLv3/TLSv1.0/TLSv1.1.
rules.remediation: Prefer TLS_client_method/TLS_server_method and explicitly allow only TLSv1.2+.

rules.message: TLS cipher suite expression contains weak or unauthenticated cipher tokens.
rules.remediation: Use a modern TLS policy that excludes NULL, export, RC4, DES/3DES, MD5, and anonymous suites.

rules.message: Manual OpenSSL PRNG seeding detected; review entropy quality and whether it is needed on supported OpenSSL versions.
rules.remediation: Rely on OpenSSL's operating-system entropy sources where possible; avoid predictable seeds such as time, pid, or stack bytes.
Increase PBKDF2 iterations and review migration to memory-hard KDFs where feasible.

rules.message: Classical public-key cryptography detected; plan post-quantum migration.
rules.remediation: Plan hybrid transition with ML-KEM/ML-DSA in compatible environments.
